### Seasoned in Prayer
Author: Rev. Kyle Norman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/seasoned-in-prayer-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Daniel 6:10
Points:
- Daniel's resilience and bravery flowed directly from a lifelong discipline of consistent prayer.
- When threatened with death, he chose not to rely on political power or compromise his walk with God.
- Daniel's prayers were offered in private, yet his devotion was known openly to the surrounding culture.
- Maintaining an active prayer life serves as a visible testimony to others when trials arise.

### What Did Daniel Pray?
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/what-did-daniel-pray-encouragement-for-today-august-8-2013.html
Passage: Daniel 6:10
Points:
- Overwhelming and uncontrollable circumstances often tempt people to seek temporary, unhealthy comforts.
- When confronted with the decree, Daniel responded not with panic or complaints, but with thanksgiving.
- Daniel's reaction was the natural result of an established daily habit of gratitude.
- Choosing praise during difficult moments shifts our perspective and leads our hearts out of despair.

### Mouth Traps
Author: Jill Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-women/mouth-traps-one-year-devotions-for-women-june-14.html
Passage: Daniel 6:22
Points:
- Just as God shut the lions' mouths, believers can trust Him to help control their speech.
- Throughout decades of exile, Daniel knew when to speak and when to remain silent.
- Daniel's restrained, godly speech won the respect of four pagan monarchs.
- Exercising control over one's tongue honors God and leaves a lasting impact on observers.

### 4 Ways to Prepare for Prayer Like Daniel
Author: Anne Graham Lotz
Site: Bible Gateway
URL: https://www.biblegateway.com/learn/voices/4-ways-to-prepare-for-prayer-like-daniel/
Passage: Daniel 6:10
Points:
- Powerful prayer that overcomes obstacles requires intentional daily preparation and habit.
- Daniel set apart a designated place and dedicated regular times each day to seek God.
- Opening his windows toward Jerusalem helped maintain an eternal focus above his immediate culture.
- Kneeling before God demonstrated an attitude of reverence, humility, and submission to His authority.
